high_level_description: The image features a sleek MacBook Air laptop placed on a wooden table. The laptop is open, displaying a desktop screen with a scenic wallpaper of a landscape featuring a tree and a clear sky. The keyboard and trackpad are visible, and the laptop appears to be in good condition. Next to the laptop, there are three books stacked on top of each other. The titles of the books are partially visible, with one book titled "Maximum City" and another titled "City." The books have colorful covers, adding a vibrant touch to the otherwise neutral tones of the scene.
